req.title: List all tasks
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /tasks/ with a JSON array of all tasks, honouring optional skip and limit query parameters.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-004 mandates GET /tasks/ returns HTTP 200 with a JSON array of all tasks, honouring optional skip and limit query parameters. Three tests are designed: (1) positive EP — default call with pre-seeded data returns HTTP 200 and a JSON array with correct count and field values, tracing directly to R-TASK-004; (2) boundary BVA — skip and limit parameters slice the dataset to an exact sub-array, verifying pagination arithmetic at boundary values skip=0,limit=1 and skip=1,limit=2; (3) negative NEG — invalid non-integer value for skip query parameter triggers HTTP 422 client error, covering the error_pathways clause of R-TASK-004.

tests.name: test_list_tasks_default_returns_all_seeded_rows
preconditions: Five task rows are inserted with known ids, titles, and completed values
No query parameters are supplied to GET /tasks/
actions: Seed database with 5 deterministic task rows
Send GET /tasks/ with no query parameters
Capture response status code and body
expected: Response body is a JSON array
First item has id=1 and title='Alpha Task' and completed=false
Fifth item has id=5 and title='Epsilon Task' and completed=true
trace: R-TASK-004: system shall respond to GET /tasks/ with a JSON array of all tasks
R-TASK-004: expected_outcomes HTTP 200 and JSON array
tests.executable:
import os
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app import models
from app.database import engine, get_db
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

seed_data = [
    {'id': 1, 'title': 'Alpha Task', 'description': 'First task', 'completed': False},
    {'id': 2, 'title': 'Beta Task', 'description': 'Second task', 'completed': False},
    {'id': 3, 'title': 'Gamma Task', 'description': 'Third task', 'completed': True},
    {'id': 4, 'title': 'Delta Task', 'description': 'Fourth task', 'completed': False},
    {'id': 5, 'title': 'Epsilon Task', 'description': 'Fifth task', 'completed': True},
]

db: Session = next(get_db())
for row in seed_data:
    t = models.Task(id=row['id'], title=row['title'], description=row['description'], completed=row['completed'])
    db.add(t)
db.commit()
db.close()

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/tasks/')
assert response.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {response.status_code}'
data = response.json()
assert isinstance(data, list), f'Expected list, got {type(data)}'
assert len(data) == 5, f'Expected 5 items, got {len(data)}'
assert data[0]['id'] == 1, f'Expected id=1, got {data[0]["id"]}'
assert data[0]['title'] == 'Alpha Task', f'Expected Alpha Task, got {data[0]["title"]}'
assert data[0]['completed'] == False, f'Expected completed=False, got {data[0]["completed"]}'
assert data[4]['id'] == 5, f'Expected id=5, got {data[4]["id"]}'
assert data[4]['title'] == 'Epsilon Task', f'Expected Epsilon Task, got {data[4]["title"]}'
assert data[4]['completed'] == True, f'Expected completed=True, got {data[4]["completed"]}'

Query parameters skip=1 and limit=2 are supplied
actions: Seed database with 5 deterministic task rows
Capture response status code and body
expected: Response body is a JSON array

Second returned item has id=3 corresponding to limit=2 boundary

R-TASK-004: boundary — skip=1 and limit=2 produce exact two-item slice

import os
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app import models
from app.database import engine, get_db
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

seed_data = [
    {'id': 1, 'title': 'Alpha Task', 'description': 'First task', 'completed': False},
    {'id': 2, 'title': 'Beta Task', 'description': 'Second task', 'completed': False},
    {'id': 3, 'title': 'Gamma Task', 'description': 'Third task', 'completed': True},
    {'id': 4, 'title': 'Delta Task', 'description': 'Fourth task', 'completed': False},
    {'id': 5, 'title': 'Epsilon Task', 'description': 'Fifth task', 'completed': True},
]

db: Session = next(get_db())
for row in seed_data:
    t = models.Task(id=row['id'], title=row['title'], description=row['description'], completed=row['completed'])
    db.add(t)
db.commit()
db.close()

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/tasks/?skip=1&limit=2')
assert response.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {response.status_code}'
data = response.json()
assert isinstance(data, list), f'Expected list, got {type(data)}'
assert len(data) == 2, f'Expected exactly 2 items with skip=1 limit=2, got {len(data)}'
assert data[0]['id'] == 2, f'Expected first item id=2 after skip=1, got {data[0]["id"]}'
assert data[1]['id'] == 3, f'Expected second item id=3 with limit=2, got {data[1]["id"]}'

tests.name: test_list_tasks_invalid_skip_type_returns_422
preconditions: Database state is irrelevant — validation occurs before query execution
Query parameter skip is set to a non-integer string value 'abc'
actions: Send GET /tasks/?skip=abc with an invalid non-integer skip value
Capture response status code and body
expected: Response body contains validation error detail
trace: R-TASK-004: error_pathways HTTP 4xx on client error
R-TASK-004: system shall honour skip query parameter — invalid type must be rejected

import os
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app import models
from app.database import engine

models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

response = client.get('/tasks/?skip=abc')
assert response.status_code == 422, f'Expected 422 for invalid skip type, got {response.status_code}'
